verses.text: Ayik ix cham winhaj Josafat chi', ix mukchaj winh yet' heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Haxo winhaj Joram yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Ix ak'ji opisio yik reyal t'a winhaj Joram chi' yuj winh smam, yujto b'ab'el unin winh. Haxo heb' winh yuk'tak winh, haton winhaj Azarías, winhaj Jehiel, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Micael yet' winhaj Sefatías. Masanil heb' winh tik, yuninal heb' winh winhaj Josafat chi'. Manh jantakok k'een oro yet' k'een plata ix siaj t'a heb' winh yuj winh smam chi' yet' juntzanhxo tas te caro stojol. Ix ak'chajpax chonhab' te wach' yajoch smuroal t'a heb' winh, haton juntzanh ay t'a yol yik Judá.
Palta a winhaj Joram chi', ayik ix tek'k'aj winh yet' yopisio chi', ix smilancham masanil heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi', ix smilpaxcham juntzanhxo heb' winh yajal winh t'a smakb'en chi'.
Ayik ix och winh reyal chi', 32 ab'il sk'inal winh, wajxake' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.

Anhej sb'eyb'al heb' winh sreyal Israel ix sb'eyb'alej winh yet' sb'eyb'al heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab, yujto a ix yetb'eyum winh, yisil ix winhaj Acab chi'. Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová.
Palta yuj sti' Jehová yak'nak t'a winhaj rey David to ol ochnhej yinhtilal winh reyal t'a masanil tiempo, yuj chi' maj yal-laj sk'ol Jehová ix satel heb' yinhtilal winhaj David chi'.
Ayik ayoch winhaj Joram chi' reyal, a heb' aj Edom, ix yik'el sb'a heb' t'a yalanh smandar Judá, ix yak'anoch sreyal heb' sch'okoj.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Joram chi' yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado yet' pax carruaje yik owal yik skanxi heb' aj Edom chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb'. Palta a heb' aj Edom chi', ix yoy sb'a heb' t'a spatik heb'. Haxo t'ak'walil ix k'e waan winhaj Joram chi' yet' heb' winh yajal yik carruaje yik syak'an owal heb'. Icha chi' ix aj sjakwi b'aj ix el heb'.

Ha heb' aj Edom chi', ix yak' ganar heb' yik'anel sb'a t'a yalanh smandar heb' aj Judá chi', ix elnhejkan heb'. Haton t'a jun pekti' chi' ix yik'paxel sb'a chonhab' Libna, yujto ix yaktejkan Jehová winhaj Joram chi', haton sDiosal heb' smam yicham winh.

Ix sb'oanxik'e juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal winh, haton b'ajtak chaanh t'a yol yik Judá chi'. Yuj chi' masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén pit ix yutej sb'a t'a Jehová. Icha chi' ix aj sjuwiel spensar heb' aj Judá chi' yuj winh.

Yuj chi' hata' ix scha jun scarta winhaj Elías schekab' Dios winhaj Joram chi', b'aj syal icha tik: Ha Jehová sDiosal winh a mam icham aj David, ha' tz'alan t'ayach: Manh wanok a b'eyb'alan sb'eyb'al winhaj rey Josafat winh a mam yet' sb'eyb'al winhaj Asa winh a mam icham,

palta to a sb'eyb'al heb' winh sreyal Israel wan a b'eyb'alani. Yuj chi' masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén, uuj pit syutej sb'a heb' t'ayin icha wal sb'eyb'al heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi'. Hanhejtona' ix a milpaxcham heb' winh uk'tak, a heb' winh chi' wach' sb'eyb'al heb' winh t'a ichanh.
Yuj chi' ol wak'em jun yaelal t'a yib'anh a chonhab' tik, t'a yib'anh heb' uninal, t'a yib'anh heb' ix etb'eyum yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tas ay t'ayach.

Ha hachxo tik, ay jun ilya ol jawok t'a ib'anh. Ol och jun ya k'ool t'ayach, junjun k'u ol te niwtajok, masanto ol yal yelta a ch'anh tza' yuj jun ilya chi', xchi Jehová, xchi jun scarta winhaj Elías chi'.
Yuj chi', a Jehová ix ak'an sk'ulej heb' filisteo yet' heb' árabe kajan t'a slak'anil Cus, ix kot heb' yak' yowal yet' winhaj rey Joram chi'.

Ix jawi heb' t'a Judá, ix yak' ganar heb'. Ix yik'b'at masanil b'eyumal heb', haton ay t'a spalacio winh rey chi', ix ik'chajb'at masanil yuninal winh yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum winh. Haxonhej winhaj Joacaz slajwub' yuninal winh ix kani.
Ayik ix lajwi yek' masanil juntzanh chi', ix yak'anoch jun ilya Jehová t'a sk'ool winhaj Joram chi', manhxa yanhal.

Ix ek' tiempo, ayik schab'il ab'il yoch jun ilya chi' t'a winh, ix elta sch'anhtza' winh yuj. Te ya ix aj scham winh. Ayik ix cham winh chi', malaj junok niwan k'ak' ix yak'och heb' anima, yujto malaj yelk'och winh t'a yol sat heb', palta ayik schamnak heb' smam yicham winh, ochnak niwak k'ak' chi'.

Ayik ix schaanel yich yak'an reyal winhaj Joram chi', 32 ab'il sk'inal winh. Wajxake' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Malaj mach ix naan winh ayik ix cham winh. Ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj David, palta manhok b'aj smukchaj heb' rey.
